title: Jaɓɓungal Addungal Kulol
intro: E nder wuro ngo bonanndeeji njuɓɓini, maccuɗo gooŋɗinɗo jaɓɓii hoɓɓe ɓe cikkaano ñalnde wootere. E nder kulhuli kisal maɓɓe, oo neɗɗo rokkii ndeenka, kono yimɓe wuro ngoo ɗaɓɓiri ɗum ko huunde hersiniinde. Jeertinaama e halkaare aroore, maccuɗo oo dogi e ɓesngu mum e nder niɓɓere, o acci wuro ngo maande mum woni halkaare. Hol oo goongɗinɗo gooto?
clues: Mi neldaama ko mi nulaaɗo e leñol waɗnoongol golle hersiniiɗe.
Hoɓɓe ɓe cikkaaka ngari e galle am, miɗo ɓuri suusde kisal maɓɓe e kisal am.
Leñol am ina ɗaɓɓi yiyde hoɓɓe am ngam anniyaaji bonɗi, miɗo etoo haaldude e maɓɓe.
Hoɓɓe am peeñninii koye mum en ko maleykaaji, njamiri mi yo mi ƴettu ɓesngu am, mi yalta jamma.
Debbo am heɗtaaki noddaango dogde, o fotndi e halkaare hono no leñol am nii.
Wuro am ɓuuɓtii e toɓo kaaƴe laylaytol, nokkuuji mum ɓurɗi toowde ngaddi les.

arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
verse: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support." (11:80)
